turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why did my son find out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
I'll stand. I have a client call at 4:40. Owen's zero is in the gradebook, Hale. Who decided that, and before or after anyone spoke to him?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
What phone call? Nobody called me, Hale, and Owen saw that zero on his phone in class. Don't manage me. Who decided, and before or after anyone spoke to him?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. The zero comes off, and I want an apology for how Owen found out. On what basis does it stand, Hale?
